title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (SHN>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC)

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a high‑energy show with standout Bird Song, Scarlet > Fire and a smoking Lazy Lightning > Supplication.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised as “wonderful,” with both sets delivering high energy; Bird Song, the Scarlet > Fire sequence and the fiery Lazy Lightning > Supplication combo are highlighted as exceptional moments. The matrix source provides a clear blend of board clarity and audience ambience, though a bit of echo on Lazy Lightning is noted. Overall the show is regarded as one of the year’s standouts with Jerry Garcia “on fire.”

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5‑star and describe it as a highlight of the year; recording is praised as a killer matrix with only minor echo issues, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear matrix mix lets you hear audience reaction; some reviewers note excess echo on Lazy Lightning and added reverb on Supplication but overall sound is crisp and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are described as wonderful; set one is solid throughout with a minor dip in Lazy Lightning due to echo, while set two “rips” from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly noted as “on fire,” especially during Fire on the Mountain and the Supplication section.
